name: product-contacts
prompt: Screen: Contacts, with "Contacts" highlighted in the sidebar. Page title "Contacts" and subtitle "Lead base: the path of every lead from first touch to a manager." Top right: an outlined "Import" button and a square amber "+" button. A search field "Name, company, phone, email" with a filter icon button. A data table with a header row: checkbox, Name, Company, Phone, Stage, Rating, Manager, Updated ↓. Twelve rows of fictional North American shippers, for example: "Dana Whitfield — Great Lakes Freight Co. — +1 (312) 555-0147 — In progress — A — Sarah Collins — Sep 15, 2026, 4:29 PM"; "Marcus Reid — Lone Star Haulers — +1 (214) 555-0183 — In progress — B — Jordan Price"; "Priya Nair — Maple Route Carriers — +1 (416) 555-0119 — Completed — A — Sarah Collins"; "Tom Becker — Midwest Cold Storage — +1 (614) 555-0110 — In queue — no rating — no manager"; plus Keystone Building Supply, Prairie Line Logistics, Harbor Point Imports, Northstar Grocers, Summit Auto Parts, Cascade Paper Mills, Blue Ridge Beverages, Pacific Coast Produce. Stage pills: "In queue" amber outline, "In progress" neutral, "Completed" green. Rating chips A, B, C, D; missing values shown as a dash. Pagination at the bottom: "25 per page" and "1–25 of 1,742". Render it as a crisp, pixel-perfect desktop web-app screenshot, flat and straight-on, with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective and no watermark. Product: "MagnaQore Logistic", an AI calling and sales system for North American freight companies. Dark theme: page background deep warm charcoal #141311; panels and cards #1d1b18 with hairline borders #2c2925 and 12px rounded corners; primary text warm off-white #ece8e1; secondary text muted warm grey #8f8a82; one accent, amber-gold #e9a23b, used for the active navigation marker, count badges, primary buttons, progress fills, active tabs and toggles; green #3fae7a only for positive statuses; lead ratings shown as small rounded chips reading A, B, C or D. Typography: a clean geometric sans-serif similar to Manrope, calm spacing, 13–15px interface text that is sharp, legible and spelled correctly. Left sidebar about 230px wide: a small muted label "MagnaQore" above the bold product name "Logistic AI" with a bell icon; navigation with thin line icons in this order: Dashboard (small amber count badge), Contacts, Dialer, Calls, Chats, Lead gen, Assistant, Settings, Help, System; at the bottom a user block "Alex Morgan" with the role "Sales ops" and a log-out icon. All people, companies, phone numbers and figures are fictional; phone numbers use the US 555 range. English only.
